transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, Press 5 has been throwing intermittent servo-drive alarms over the last two production weeks, and we've got a replacement servo retrofit kit ready in the storeroom. We have the Saturday maintenance window from 06:00 to 16:00 available, and I need to make the call on whether we take Press 5 offline for the retrofit. Before I finalize the work order, I need findings from each of your areas -- controls engineering, production planning, safety, and quality. Plant policy requires documented findings from all four before I can approve the work. So let's go around: what are you each seeing that's relevant to this decision?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Elena, from controls engineering: I completed a bench test this morning confirming the retrofit requires exactly 2 hours for controller-parameter backup and restoration, followed by exactly 6 hours of controlled commissioning — 8 hours total. That fits within the 06:00 to 16:00 Saturday window. I haven't attached the bench-test note to the work order yet, but I'll get that documented.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: From production planning: I confirmed the released schedule this morning — 480 housings are due for Monday shipment. Press 2 can make exactly 240 of them on Saturday, and the remaining exactly 240 must be assigned to Press 5 after the retrofit. I haven't updated the shared schedule yet because the maintenance decision is still open.
